factProposals.value: Front desk staff, office managers and admins can register patients: the new RegisterPatients permission is granted to exactly those three roles; dentists, hygienists, assistants and billing cannot (the API returns 403 and the nav link is hidden).

A registered patient holds demographics (first, middle and last name, date of birth as a calendar date, optional sex) and contact details (phone, optional email, address with city, state and postal code). Required: first name, last name, date of birth, phone, address line 1, city, state, postal code.
Registration is a POST to /api/patients that requires an Idempotency-Key header and a CSRF token; the front-desk form sends one key per registration attempt and reuses it on a retry.

Registration refuses: incomplete or invalid input (400 with a message per field, nothing stored), the same person again (409 naming the existing patient), a missing idempotency key (400), and any registration whose audit entry cannot be written (the patient is rolled back with it). Two simultaneous registrations of one person produce exactly one patient.

Every registration writes a PatientRegistered audit entry, in the same save as the patient, recording the registering user and a timestamp. The entry holds no patient names or contact data; it points at the patient by id.
A successful registration returns 201 with the stored patient and its id; a retry with the same idempotency key returns 200 with the same patient.

decisions.statement: Registration is limited to demographics and contact details. REQ-004's family/household relationships clause is left to the companion story ALV-003-C01 and was not built here.
decisions.rationale: STORY-003's three acceptance criteria do not mention households, and the master plan's own gap analysis assigns household and a separate guarantor to ALV-003-C01.

decisions.statement: A unique database index on a normalized last-name, first-name and date-of-birth key blocks a second registration of the same person.
decisions.rationale: It is the only guarantee that holds when two registrations race; the friendly pre-check alone cannot. It is also stricter than a duplicate warning, so a later story that wants warn-and-override will have to relax it.

decisions.statement: The registration idempotency key is stored on the patient row (a unique filtered index) so a retry returns the original patient, instead of using the shared idempotency receipt table.
decisions.rationale: The receipt table does not record which entity a command created, and a retry has to return that same patient.

decisions.statement: The audit entry is staged in the same SaveChanges as the patient rather than written afterward.
decisions.rationale: A registration can then never exist without its audit trail, which satisfies the trust criterion even when audit storage fails.

limitations.statement: No household or family relationships and no separate guarantor: REQ-004 is only partly satisfied by this story. ALV-003-C01 is planned to complete it.
Patients can only be registered and read back by id. There is no patient search, edit, active/inactive state or duplicate-warning override yet; a duplicate is refused outright.
Only front desk, office manager and admin hold RegisterPatients, and reading a patient by id uses the same permission, so clinical roles cannot yet open the record this story creates.

Phone and email checks are shape checks only (at least 7 digits; one @ with a dot after it). Addresses are free text with no postal validation, and dates of birth before 1900 or in the future are rejected.
